lead.title: Voter registration closes today
lead.summary: Mailed applications need an October 5-or-earlier postmark for the November 3 election. Request a manual postmark at the postal counter; mailbox pickup may be too late.
lead.detail: October 5 only: the Nelda Wells Spears Building, 2433 Ridgepoint Drive, accepts registration from 8 a.m. to midnight. Other county offices have different hours.

goodThing.title: A birthday tradition that gives something back
goodThing.summary: Chloe Brown turned 19 at a September 29 campus blood drive. In a Sunday report, she told The Daily Texan why she gives blood on her birthday each year.
